scientific_limitations: Only centered ellipsoids and Haar-uniform central hyperplanes, with the same normal for section and projection.
The closed two-dimensional joint density requires dimension three and three distinct semiaxes; higher dimensions use a Dirichlet pushforward.
The normal coordinate signs remain indeterminate; only their squares are recovered.
Historical priority of the paired formulation is provisional; no independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
title: Positive dependence and complete joint section–shadow law for ellipsoids
